entities.summary: George Mireku Duker is a Ghanaian politician. He servied as a Deputy Minister at Ghana's Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources from 2021 to 2025 and was the former Member of Parliament for Tarkwa-Nsuaem between 2017 and 2025. He was elected into parliament on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.
